fieldData.awb---mockup-data: window.awbMockup = { floorStaff: "I run a food packing plant where line staff have no company email. Build an employee feedback form they open from a QR code by the time clock. Ask them to pick a topic first: equipment, schedules, pay, or something else. Send equipment notes to our maintenance lead and schedule notes to the shift manager, and mark each comment Received, Assigned, or Done.", oneOnOnePrep: "I manage a team of software engineers. Build a short form each engineer fills in on Wednesday before our Thursday one-on-one, with 3 questions: what went well, what is stuck, and what they need from me. Show me the answers before we meet, and bring any item marked Stuck back on the next week's form until I mark it Resolved.", draftPolicies: "I work in HR at a group of health clinics. Build a form where staff comment on a draft policy for 14 days, choosing the section each comment is about. Show me the comments grouped by section with a count for each, so I can see which section drew the most before the policy takes effect.", newToolRollouts: "I run dispatch for a freight company that just switched routing apps. Build a feedback form dispatchers fill in after 2 weeks: a rating from 1 to 5 and a box for what slows them down. Send any comment with a score of 2 or lower to our IT lead by email, and list every rating in a table I can sort." };

acrm---key-feature-4-image.alt: Kestrow Freight dispatchers' ratings of the new routing app after 2 weeks, where Bo Lindgren's score of 2 for a reroute that takes 4 taps is sent to IT lead Halsey Ruiz.
